The kubeconfig for staging lives in the ops vault.
Postgres replica lag pages the on-call.
Postgres major upgrades need a maintenance window.
The primary Postgres cluster runs in two availability zones.
Redis is used as the session cache for the web tier.
Rotate the CI deploy credentials every ninety days.
Database credentials are stored in the secrets manager.
Terraform state for production is locked in a remote backend.
Production deploys freeze on Friday afternoons.
Load balancer health checks hit the readiness endpoint every ten seconds.
The staging cluster is rebuilt from scratch every Sunday night.
Feature flags are managed in the flag service, not in config files.
Log retention for application logs is thirty days.
Metrics dashboards live in the observability folder.
DNS changes take up to an hour to propagate.
TLS certificates renew automatically thirty days before expiry.
The message queue retries failed jobs five times before dead lettering.
Container images are scanned for vulnerabilities on every push.
Disk usage alerts fire at eighty percent on database hosts.
Network outages at the data center are announced on the status page.
Past outages are listed in the incident tracker with their timelines.
Staging config mirrors production except for smaller instance sizes.
The config loader reads environment variables before config files.
Cron jobs for reports run in the scheduler cluster.
The CDN caches static assets for one week.
Backups are restored to staging monthly to test recovery.
Kafka topics are partitioned by customer region.
The search index is rebuilt nightly from the primary database.
Elevated error rates on the gateway usually mean an upstream outage.
SSH access to production requires a short-lived certificate.
The VPN config is distributed through the device management tool.
Staging outages do not page anyone outside business hours.
Rate limits for the public API are one hundred requests per second.
Service owners are listed in the service catalog.
Secrets must never be committed to source control.
Most outages last year came from expired certificates.
Database migrations run before the application deploy step.
The build cache is cleared when the base image changes.
